title: LP Transfer logs use their own to address as the withdrawal destination, so an allowlisted withdrawal can still trip the exit

evidence.note: Transfer destination is its own to address
Burn and Transfer both evaluated as a V2 multi-signal

evidence.ref: sed -n 1521,1533p and 2247,2256p of the base snapshot (22-27 merge)
evidence.note: Claude verification: lines re-read. Not reproduced.

sibling_sites_checked: AUD-ANTIRUG-003 records that each log counts separately. An LP lock to a locker does not reduce supply, so signal 1 does not trip on it (AUD-ANTIRUG-006).
severity_rationale: S3 candidate: a false positive selling a position that did not need to exit, and only for allowlisted withdrawals.
recommendation: Take the allowlist destination from the Burn of the same removal; decide in card ANTIRUG-01. Phase 29 (S2-S4). Nothing is fixed in Phase 22 (NAC-13).
